i will tell you about it. First, we look at the first thing, which is the thing we think is real and not wrong. Second, we look after that, which is my other idea. Third, we look to see if the next thing must be true because of the first thing.

If the next part follows from the first thing in a way that cannot be broken, then the next part comes from the first.
